description: Unofficial fan art of Sayaka Miki from Puella Magi Madoka Magica. A youthful companion with paper-note rhythm, a long white cape cross-step, careful balancing of a fully closed blunt display sheath, and three athletic running directions. Opaque high-neck long sleeves and white tights are modest adaptations. No blade is drawn and no attack occurs. Independent original animation; no affiliation or endorsement.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
